tc_noticeboard.gui.title: Notice Board
tc_noticeboard.gui.empty: Nothing is pinned yet. Write a title and your notice below, then Post: citizens near the board read it, spread the word, and some pin a reply.
tc_noticeboard.gui.no_replies: No replies yet. Citizens near the board pin theirs over the next few minutes.
tc_noticeboard.gui.hint: Post pins the notice here and replaces the old one. Announce tells every citizen at once, without pinning anything.
